turns.reply:
I made two edge-case fixes in `rich/cells.py` for the ZWJ and variation-selector handling, and submitted the patch. The issue text was vague and I did not have the hidden tests, so I worked from the code alone.

- **Trailing ZWJ in `_cell_len`:** `next(iter_characters)` raised `StopIteration` when a ZWJ was the last character; it now uses `next(iter_characters, None)`.
- **ZWJ and VS16 in `split_graphemes`:** a ZWJ at the end could push the span end past the text length, so the index is now clamped to `codepoint_count`. A leading variation selector (VS16 with no preceding character) never advanced the index, which would loop forever; it now always advances by one.

`tests/test_cells.py` passes (54 tests), and direct checks of the trailing-ZWJ and leading-VS16 inputs return without hanging or raising. I did not add tests for these cases.
